answer: Require every agent identity to carry a deposit that is locked while it works and lost if it cheats. A new identity must also build trust slowly through completed jobs before it can take large orders. An attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must fund each deposit and wait through the same slow history, so the cost rises with every fake. A public record of completed work makes that history easy to check, like a river whose course is visible from source to zenith, and a crystal clear trail lets buyers skip agents with no past. Fakes stay possible, but they stop being cheap.
